name: BROKEN: salt and sodium disagree by the 2.5 factor
source_note: Positive control for the salt conversion. The panel declares 120 mg of sodium and 0.12 g of salt, which is the same number twice. Annex I point 11 makes the salt equivalent 0.30 g. This is the error a manufacturer makes by relabelling a US panel for the EU market without applying the factor.
